summary.text: Nick Pisciottano is a Democrat from Allegheny County who was elected in November 2024 to represent Pennsylvania's 45th Senatorial District, after serving two terms in the state House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: Pisciottano graduated from West Mifflin Area High School in 2008, earned a B.A. in accounting and history from Washington and Jefferson College in 2012, and a master's degree in Data Analytics & Policy from Johns Hopkins University in 2019. He is a certified public accountant and auditor.

His district covers 37 communities, including the Monongahela Valley and Pittsburgh's eastern and southern suburbs. He is a fourth-generation Monongahela Valley resident and former president of the West Mifflin Community Foundation, and lives in his hometown with his wife Molly and their three children.
